class Bag{public (List<Item>,int) CPair=([],0);public int Calls=0;public (List<int>,int) Capture(){Calls+=1;return Rows[0];}public List<(Dictionary<string,int>,int)> DRows=[];public List<(Set<int>,int)> SRows=[];public List<(List<List<int>>,int)> LRows=[];public List<(List<Item>,int)> CRows=[];public List<(List<int>,int)> Rows=[];public List<((List<int>,int),int)> Nested=[];public Dictionary<string,(List<int>,int)> Map={};public (List<int>,int) Pair=([1],2);public List<int> Values=[1]; public bool Append(){(List<int>,int)t=Rows[0];t.Item1.Add(3);return t.Item1[t.Item1.Count-1]==3;} public bool Check(){return Rows[0].Item1.Count==2&&Rows[0].Item1[1]==3;} }
class G<T>{public List<(List<T>,int)> Rows=[];}
class Probe{

public static bool IndexWriteBack(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1],2));b.Rows.Add(([9],3));(List<int>,int)t=b.Rows[0];t.Item1.Add(4);b.Rows[1]=t;return b.Rows[1].Item1.Count==2&&b.Rows[1].Item1[1]==4;}
public static bool DictTupleEquality(){Bag b=new Bag();b.DRows.Add(({"a":1},2));(Dictionary<string,int>,int)t=b.DRows[0];t.Item1["b"]=2;return t==b.DRows[0]&&b.DRows.Contains(t);}
public static bool SetTupleEquality(){Bag b=new Bag();List<int> l0=[1];Set<int> s0=l0.ToSet();b.SRows.Add((s0,2));(Set<int>,int)t=b.SRows[0];t.Item1.Add(3);return t==b.SRows[0]&&b.SRows.Contains(t);}

public static bool ClassListCopyControl(){Bag b=new Bag();Item x=new Item();x.V=7;b.CRows.Add(([x],2));b.CRows.Add(b.CRows[0]);return b.CRows[1].Item1.Count==1&&b.CRows[1].Item1[0].V==7&&b.CRows[1].Item1[0]==x;}
public static bool ClassPairWriteBack(){Bag b=new Bag();Item x=new Item();x.V=7;b.CRows.Add(([x],2));(List<Item>,int)t=b.CRows[0];b.CPair=t;return b.CPair.Item1.Count==1&&b.CPair.Item1[0]==x;}

public static bool DictWriteBack(){Bag b=new Bag();b.DRows.Add(({"a":1},2));(Dictionary<string,int>,int)t=b.DRows[0];t.Item1["b"]=2;b.DRows.Add(t);return b.DRows[1].Item1.Count==2&&b.DRows[1].Item1["b"]==2;}

public static bool SetWriteBack(){Bag b=new Bag();List<int> l0=[1];Set<int> s0=l0.ToSet();b.SRows.Add((s0,2));(Set<int>,int)t=b.SRows[0];t.Item1.Add(3);b.SRows.Add(t);return b.SRows[1].Item1.Count==2&&b.SRows[1].Item1.Contains(3);}

public static bool NestedWriteBack(){Bag b=new Bag();b.LRows.Add(([[1]],2));(List<List<int>>,int)t=b.LRows[0];t.Item1[0].Add(3);b.LRows.Add(t);return b.LRows[1].Item1[0].Count==2&&b.LRows[1].Item1[0][1]==3;}
public static bool UnchangedCopyControl(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1],2));b.Rows.Add(b.Rows[0]);return b.Rows[1].Item1.Count==1&&b.Rows[1].Item1[0]==1;}

public static bool LocalTupleWhilePending(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1],2));(List<int>,int)t=([1],2);t.Item1.Add(3);t.Item1.Add(4);b.Rows.Add(([5],6));return t.Item1.Count==3&&t.Item1[2]==4&&b.Rows.Count==2;}
public static bool LocalTupleInterleaved(){Bag b=new Bag();(List<int>,int)t=([1],2);for(int i=0;i<3;i++){b.Rows.Add(([i],i));t.Item1.Add(i);}return t.Item1.Count==4&&t.Item1[3]==2&&b.Rows.Count==3;}
public static bool BindInLoop(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([0],0));(List<int>,int)t=b.Rows[0];for(int i=0;i<5;i++){t.Item1.Add(i);(List<int>,int)u=t;}return t.Item1.Count==6;}
public static bool PassInLoop(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([0],0));(List<int>,int)t=b.Rows[0];int s=0;for(int i=0;i<5;i++){t.Item1.Add(i);s+=Second(t);}return t.Item1.Count==6&&s==0;}

public static bool TupleHashMembership(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1],2));(List<int>,int)t=b.Rows[0];List<(List<int>,int)>l=[t];Set<(List<int>,int)>s=l.ToSet();if(!s.Contains(t)){return false;}t.Item1.Add(3);return s.Contains(b.Rows[0])&&s.Contains(t);}
public static bool DifferentTupleHandles(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1],2));b.Rows.Add(([1],2));(List<int>,int)t=b.Rows[0];t.Item1.Add(3);b.Rows[1].Item1.Add(3);return t!=b.Rows[1];}
public static bool ReceiverOnce(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1],2));b.Capture().Item1.Add(3);b.Capture().Item1.Add(4);return b.Calls==2&&b.Rows[0].Item1.Count==3;}
public static bool LoopReads(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1],2));(List<int>,int)t=b.Rows[0];for(int i=0;i<10;i++){t.Item1.Add(i);if(t.Item1.Count!=i+2||t.Item1[i+1]!=i){return false;}}return true;}
public static bool WriteBackPair(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1],2));(List<int>,int)t=b.Rows[0];t.Item1.Add(3);b.Pair=t;return b.Pair.Item1.Count==2&&b.Pair.Item1[1]==3;}
public static bool AddBack(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1],2));(List<int>,int)t=b.Rows[0];t.Item1.Add(3);b.Rows.Add(t);return b.Rows[1].Item1.Count==2&&b.Rows[1].Item1[1]==3;}
public static bool MapWrite(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1],2));(List<int>,int)t=b.Rows[0];t.Item1.Add(3);b.Map["x"]=t;return b.Map["x"].Item1.Count==2;}
public static bool TupleEquality(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1],2));(List<int>,int)t=b.Rows[0];t.Item1.Add(3);return t==b.Rows[0];}
public static bool ReturnTuple(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1],2));return Get(b).Item1.Count==2&&Get(b).Item1[2]==3;}
public static bool Deconstruct(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1],2));(List<int>,int)t=b.Rows[0];t.Item1.Add(3);var (l,n)=t;return l.Count==2&&l[1]==3&&n==2;}
public static bool DeconstructThenAdd(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1],2));(List<int>,int)t=b.Rows[0];var (l,n)=t;l.Add(3);return t.Item1.Count==2&&l.Count==2;}
public static bool ForeachDeconstruct(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1],2));foreach((List<int> l,int n) in b.Rows){l.Add(3);return l[1]==3;}return false;}
public static bool LoopAdds(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1],2));(List<int>,int)t=b.Rows[0];for(int i=0;i<3;i++){t.Item1.Add(i);}return t.Item1.Count==4&&t.Item1[3]==2;}
public static bool DictInTuple(){Bag b=new Bag();b.DRows.Add(({"a":1},2));(Dictionary<string,int>,int)t=b.DRows[0];t.Item1["b"]=2;return t.Item1.Count==2&&t.Item1["b"]==2;}
public static bool SetInTuple(){Bag b=new Bag();List<int> l0=[1];Set<int> s0=l0.ToSet();b.SRows.Add((s0,2));(Set<int>,int)t=b.SRows[0];t.Item1.Add(3);return t.Item1.Count==2&&t.Item1.Contains(3);}

public static bool NestedListInTuple(){Bag b=new Bag();b.LRows.Add(([[1]],2));(List<List<int>>,int)t=b.LRows[0];t.Item1[0].Add(3);t.Item1.Add([4]);return t.Item1[0].Count==2&&t.Item1.Count==2&&t.Item1[1][0]==4;}
public static bool ReplacedPair(){Bag b=new Bag();(List<int>,int)t=b.Pair;b.Pair=([9],9);t.Item1.Add(3);return t.Item1.Count==2&&b.Pair.Item1.Count==1;}
public static bool StaleViaOtherRead(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1],2));(List<int>,int)t=b.Rows[0];b.Rows[0].Item1.Add(3);return t.Item1.Count==2;}
public static bool ContainsTupleList(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1],2));(List<int>,int)t=b.Rows[0];t.Item1.Add(3);return b.Rows.Contains(t);}
public static bool ClassListInTuple(){Bag b=new Bag();b.CRows.Add(([],2));(List<Item>,int)t=b.CRows[0];Item x=new Item();x.V=7;t.Item1.Add(x);return t.Item1.Count==1&&t.Item1[0].V==7&&t.Item1[0]==x;}
public static bool AddIndex(){Bag b=new Bag(); b.Rows.Add(([1],2)); foreach((List<int>,int) t in b.Rows){t.Item1.Add(3);return t.Item1[1]==3&&t.Item2==2;}return false;}
public static bool Insert(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1],2));(List<int>,int)t=b.Rows[0];t.Item1.Insert(0,3);return t.Item1[0]==3&&t.Item1[1]==1;}
public static bool Remove(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1,2],2));(List<int>,int)t=b.Rows[0];t.Item1.Remove(1);return t.Item1.Count==1&&t.Item1[0]==2;}
public static bool RemoveAt(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1,2],2));(List<int>,int)t=b.Rows[0];t.Item1.RemoveAt(0);return t.Item1.Count==1&&t.Item1[0]==2;}
public static bool Clear(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1],2));(List<int>,int)t=b.Rows[0];t.Item1.Clear();return t.Item1.Count==0;}
public static bool SetIndex(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1],2));(List<int>,int)t=b.Rows[0];t.Item1[0]=3;return t.Item1[0]==3;}
public static bool OtherAlias(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1],2));(List<int>,int)t=b.Rows[0];List<int>a=t.Item1;a.Add(3);return t.Item1[1]==3&&a[1]==3;}
public static bool TupleCopies(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1],2));(List<int>,int)t=b.Rows[0];(List<int>,int)u=t;t.Item1.Add(3);return u.Item1[1]==3;}

public static bool OtherFunction(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1],2));(List<int>,int)t=b.Rows[0];AppendList(t.Item1);return t.Item1[1]==3;}

public static bool LocalControl(){List<int>a=[1];(List<int>,int)t=(a,2);a.Add(3);return t.Item1[1]==3;}
public static bool LocalTupleMutation(){(List<int>,int)t=([1],2);t.Item1.Add(3);return t.Item1[1]==3;}

public static bool AppendTuple((List<int>,int)t){t.Item1.Add(3);return t.Item1[1]==3;}

public static Bag Create(){Bag b=new Bag();b.Rows.Add(([1],2));return b;}
